name: Create Presentation Outline
problem: I have the core idea for a presentation, but I struggle to organize it into a clear structure that tells a compelling story.
when_to_use: Use when preparing a project presentation, intern demo, status update, or final recap deck.
use_cases: create an outline for an intern project presentation
turn project notes into a slide structure
prepare a demo presentation for a manager review
organize ideas for a final internship presentation
instructions: Given a presentation topic, audience, and goal, generate a clear outline with a logical flow. Include a suggested title, key sections, and short descriptions of what each part should cover. Keep the structure concise and presentation-ready.

example.input: I need to present my internship project and explain the problem, the solution, and what I learned.
example.output:
Title: Improving Skill Discovery and Reuse
- Problem: Why finding and reusing skills is difficult today
- Approach: How the project explored a structured solution
- Progress: Key work completed so far
- Impact: Why this matters for teams and users
- Learnings and Next Steps: What was learned and where the project could go next
